headline: Custodian Investment nine-month pre-tax profit rises 25.52% to N66.20B
summary: Custodian Investment Plc reported a pre-tax profit of N66.20 billion for the nine months ended September 30, 2026, marking a 25.52% increase compared to N52.74 billion in the same period of 2025.
why: Corporate earnings reports provide key fundamental data for investors assessing the profitability and growth trajectory of Nigerian financial services firms.
